Academic Advising
Academic Advising inquiries for all Science
programs

Although academic advising is available for all students,
in all cases, it is solely the responsibility of students to ensure that they are properly registered and meet course requirements and the requirements of the program for which they are registered
. All students should review the
University Undergraduate Regulations
chapter and the relevant program requirements and course information carefully.
